subject: Re: Intro: Packetlytics + Redwood Inference — Discovery / missed call
body:
---Message 1 (calendar invite)---
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ewalker@packetlytics.com>
Date: 2025-06-29 09:00 PDT
Subject: Intro: Packetlytics + Redwood Inference — Discovery (15m)

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for taking time to talk. I booked a quick 15-minute discovery to walk through where Redwood might help cut inference costs and tighten latency for your production pipelines.

When: Mon, Jun 30 · 10:00 AM – 10:15 AM PDT
Where: Zoom (link in calendar invite)
Agenda: 1) Your current inference stack, 2) 1 quick use case we can help optimize, 3) next steps

If that window no longer works, feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-intro?fallback=packetlytics

Best,
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
---

---Message 2 (no-show follow-up from SDR)---
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ewalker@packetlytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-30 10:15 PDT
Subject: Quick note — we missed our 10am (3 fast options)

Hey Ethan —

Looks like we missed each other for the 10:00 AM slot. Totally understand things pop up — quick note with three ways to move forward so this is low-effort on your side: 

1) Fast rebook: pick any 15-min window that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-intro?fallback=packetlytics

2) Async POV: watch a 2-minute product tour + spin up a sandbox token (no credit card). If this is easier, I can follow up with a short, tailored note on how Redwood would map to Packetlytics' inference topology. Links below and I attached a one-page prep checklist.
   - 2-min tour: https://drive.redwood.com/packetlytics/2min-demo.mp4
   - Sandbox: https://sandbox.redwood.com/invite?token=pk_abc123

3) Email-first: tell me the one thing you care most about (latency, unit cost, multi-region routing), and I’ll send a short plan and a sample ROI estimate — no meeting required.

If you prefer, I can also loop in Ben (our AE) for a slightly longer session that includes technical sizing.

Attachments: prep-checklist.pdf (1-page: what we'll ask, what to have ready)

Appreciate it — either reply with a preferred slot, click the demo link, or tell me what you'd like to see by email.

Thanks,
Irene
SDR | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0146
irene_choi@redwood.com
---

---Message 3 (prospect reply)---
From: Ethan Walker <ewalker@packetlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30 17:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick note — we missed our 10am (3 fast options)

Hi Irene,

Sorry — a last-minute rollout caught me this morning. Thanks for the options. I can do a 30-minute slot tomorrow (Tue, Jul 1) at 11:00 AM PDT if Ben can join to cover sizing. Otherwise the async demo + sandbox looks good and I can poke around first.

If you can confirm Ben's availability for 11:00 tomorrow, please send the invite. If not, I’ll try the sandbox later today.

Thanks,
Ethan Walker
Senior Data Engineer
Packetlytics
ewalker@packetlytics.com
---

---Message 4 (confirmation + invite)---
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ewalker@packetlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-01 08:30 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick note — confirmed Tue 11am (30m) + agenda

Perfect — thanks Ethan. Ben confirmed and I just sent a calendar invite (attached: confirmed-invite.ics).

Agenda (30m)
- 5m quick intros
- 10m current infra + key pain (latency / cost / multi-region)
- 10m tailored demo & sizing sketch
- 5m next steps (trial/sandbox + success metrics)

If there's anything specific you want us to bring (example traces, token volumes), reply and we’ll prep. Otherwise see you Tue Jul 1 · 11:00–11:30 AM PDT (Zoom link in the invite).

Thanks again — looking forward to it.

Best,
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Phone: 415-555-0146

---End of thread---
